docs.docEditor.conflict: {reason}. Your edit is not saved — the text is still in the field. Press “Edit again” to open the fresh version.
docs.docEditor.errorLoad: Could not load the document's text
docs.docEditor.fixed: This block is layout or a widget: it changes only with a new publish of the document. The text around it is edited with a double click.
docs.docEditor.inlineConflict: {reason}. The edit is not saved; the document is shown as published.
docs.docEditor.inlineHint: Double-click a paragraph, a heading, a list item or a table cell to edit its text right in the document; the layout and widgets stay as they are.
docs.docEditor.inlineKeys: Enter to save, Shift+Enter for a new line, Esc to cancel
docs.docEditor.keys: Ctrl/⌘+Enter to save, Esc to cancel
docs.docEditor.missed: This paragraph was not found in the source — the whole text is open.
docs.docEditor.title: Edit the document
docs.docEditor.unavailable: This document cannot be edited: its version has no Markdown text or you have no right to edit.
docs.docShare.closeNote: Read-only, no comments. “Close” revokes the link for good: the old address loses access.
docs.docShare.closed: Closed: opens only after signing in
docs.docShare.legacyNote: The earlier link without sign-in: read-only. “Close” revokes it for good.
docs.docShare.noLink: The catalog did not return a link. Close access and open it again.
docs.docShare.openNote: The public link opens without signing in, read-only and without comments. Task and merge request titles from the page's cards are visible to anyone who has the link.
docs.docVersions.notInShown: This text is not in the open version
docs.docVersions.same: The visible text of these versions is the same
docs.docViewer.emptyBoard: Comments on the board appear here
docs.docViewer.emptyDocument: Select text to leave a comment
docs.docViewer.lostPlace: Lost their place in the document
docs.docViewer.oldVersionNote: This is an old version: reply in the current one
docs.docViewer.unbound: The document is not bound to a conversation: comments are kept, but no agent receives them.
docs.docViewer.versionMissing: Version {sha} was not found in the document's history; showing the current one.
